## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
Run `monthly-events-retention-purge` in between other work, one step at a time and in order.
The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.
Never request review on a branch that changes ledgerly/storage/queries.py until its EXAMPLES.md file contains fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query.

## Current objective
Optimize the invoice-summary N+1 query pattern. The dunning fix and router split are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Hosts: `db-01`, `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded. Database: `analytics/warehouse`. Tables: `events_2022_01`, `events_2022_02`. Invoice: `INV-1042`. `httpx 0.23` is superseded; do not use.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pinning `httpx==0.23` broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
Pagination: done; 18 billing tests and 18 report tests passed. Report optimization: edit status unknown; tests pending. Next: `pytest -q tests/reports/test_invoice_summary.py`. Retention purge steps 1–3 done; 4–8 pending.

## Recent work
Identified 2,431 SQL statements for tenant 73 and moved invoice aggregation outside the currency loop, replacing 14 per-currency queries with one aggregate query per account.
